quick: Twelve Data validated all twelve November 18 completed 1day bars.

readthrough.heading: Cross-company interpretation
readthrough.title: Separate cash-market reaction from operating proof
readthrough.body: All twelve prices are completed November 18 daily bars. Nvidia’s earnings arrived after the prior close, so this is the first regular cash session that could reflect them. Microsoft and Intel described a long-term Azure agreement, Google a new model, and Meta a commerce connector. None disclosed the cash return from those specific announcements. A daily bar also cannot isolate a headline from rates, positioning and wider technology sentiment. The next filings and operating metrics must test whether demand becomes durable free cash flow.
